summary: Build Compliance and Statutory Reporting module for PIT tax (05/KK-TNCN, 05/QTT-TNCN), Social Insurance (SI/HI/UI/Trade Union, D02-LT), and Labor Utilization (01/PLI) under Vietnamese legal regulations
acceptance: Implement RPT-TAX-01 PIT periodic declaration (Form 05/KK-TNCN) and progressive 7-tier tax brackets with payroll slip reconciliation
Implement RPT-TAX-02 PIT annual finalization (Form 05/QTT-TNCN & 05-1/BK-TNCN) with proxy authorization and tax balance settlement
Implement RPT-INS-01 statutory insurance contributions (SI 8%/17.5%, HI 1.5%/3%, UI 1%/1%, Trade Union 2%) with statutory wage caps
Implement RPT-INS-02 insurance labor fluctuations (Form D02-LT) tracking enrollments, terminations, and salary adjustments
Implement RPT-LAB-01 bi-annual/annual labor utilization reporting (Form 01/PLI per Decree 145/2020/ND-CP)
Integrate filters, UTF-8 BOM CSV exports, audit logging, and responsive UI in ReportingCenter
Enforce strict tenant isolation, RBAC (HR/ADMIN only), audit logging, and regression tests
